args.title: Fix issue 4403 in src/export/csv.ts
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The file src/export/csv.ts explains the issue; it prefixes a UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM) to CSV exports by default with the option 'bom' set true. This is deliberate for spreadsheet apps to detect UTF-8 encoding when opening directly, so the BOM will stay unless the option is changed.
